title: Grav Form plugin 1.1.0 before 9.1.40 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Form::uploadFiles(),…
description: The Grav Form plugin versions 1.1.0 up to but not including 9.1.40 contain a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the Form::uploadFiles() function. This vulnerability arises because the plugin sanitizes SVG files only when the file's last extension is .svg, allowing files with additional extensions (e.g., drawing.svg.foo) to bypass sanitization. An anonymous attacker can exploit this by uploading malicious files through public upload forms, which execute scripts in an administrator's session when opened. This can lead to the creation of a super-admin account on Grav 2.x installations using Admin2.
